neighbours.label: additive 'also' that adds a further point to what was just said, in news or report prose, as against the same sentences without it
fire: The mayor opened the new library on Monday. He also announced plans for a pool.
The company reported higher profits. It is also hiring two hundred new staff.
The spokesman said the road would close. He added that buses would also be diverted.
The park has a large lake for boating. There are also several picnic areas nearby.
Bring warm clothes for the hike. Also, pack enough water for the whole day.
The singer won three awards last year. She is also one of the festival's judges.
The study links exercise to better sleep. It also found lower stress levels.
The minister praised the nurses. She added that more funding would also follow.
